entities.description: A white office chair with a high backrest and armrests, featuring a dark blue base with five wheels. The chair is partially occupied by a person wearing a dark suit and a blue tie.

attributes.occupant: person in a dark suit and blue tie

entities.description: A dark blue computer monitor is shown from the back, featuring a thick bezel and a central circular mount connecting to a sturdy, angled stand. The monitor is positioned on a light blue surface against a background of pink and white abstract shapes.
A flat, light blue desk with a rectangular top and two visible dark blue legs is positioned in the foreground. The desk has a simple, modern design with clean lines and a smooth surface.

attributes.material: smooth, possibly plastic or painted wood

entities.description: A young man with dark hair and a light complexion is seated in a white office chair, wearing a dark grey suit jacket, a white collared shirt, and a bright blue tie. He has a cheerful expression with an open-mouthed smile and is gesturing with both hands raised, one palm open and the other in a loose fist, suggesting an animated conversation or presentation.

attributes.pose: sitting in a chair, leaning slightly forward, both arms raised in a gesture

entities.description: A young woman with long dark hair and a fair complexion is seated at a desk, wearing a white long-sleeved top. She is smiling and looking at a smartphone held in her left hand, which displays a call icon and is connected to a computer monitor on the left by a black cable.

A blue speech bubble with a rounded rectangular shape and two small triangular tails at the bottom, containing three horizontal white lines of varying lengths representing text. The background is a solid light pink color.
